::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
India teams in Bengaluru contribute to Cisco's Silicon One networking ASICs for enterprise and data centre switches and routers, including design-for-test and physical design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Networking ASIC design, verification, DFT and physical design for Cisco's Silicon One switching and routing platforms.

| **Progress** | <span class="complexity-bar" title="Progress: 2.5/5"><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment filled"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span><span class="complexity-segment"></span></span> 2.5/5 | Design completeness 3, India scale 2 |

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** High-bandwidth switching/routing ASICs (51.2T-102.4T class).
- **Strategic depth 3/5:** Bengaluru teams contribute to Silicon One chip development; programme leadership remains in the US.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** Postings cite full-chip integration, timing and DFT work; not India-owned end-to-end chips.
- **India scale 2/5:** No silicon-specific headcount reported; estimate kept.
